In the upcoming NBA game between Warriors and Spurs, originally scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026 at 9:30 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Warriors win, the market will resolve to "Warriors".
If the Spurs win, the market will resolve to "Spurs".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
